title: AstraZeneca plans direct listing on New York Stock Exchange but isn’t quitting London
summary: UK’s biggest drugmaker confirms HQ will stay in Cambridge but with London listing now on equal footing with NYSE GSK’s Emma Walmsley to be replaced as CEO Business live – latest updates The UK’s biggest drugmaker AstraZeneca has said it will directly list its shares on the New York Stock Exchange, putting them on an equal footing to its London listing, but affirmed its headquarters will stay in the UK. The FTSE 100 company said its direct listing in New York will replace trading in its “American depositary receipts” (ADRs) – which give US investors exposure to a non-US company – on the Nasdaq.
